name: Russian IR Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset and evaluation suite for measuring the effectiveness of information retrieval models on Russian-language corpora, focusing on ranking and retrieval metrics.
reputation: Specialized benchmark for Russian-language IR with modest adoption within Russian IR research groups but limited international use.
notes: Language-specific (Russian) morphology and stopword behavior can affect cross-lingual transfer; likely limited scale and domain coverage. Primarily an IR (non-LLM) benchmark though modern evaluations may use neural rerankers.
